contactSupport.answer: You can reach our support team via the "Contact Us" option available in the app.
contactSupport.question: How do I contact support?

manageNotifications.answer: Open Profile → Notifications to control which alerts you receive.
manageNotifications.question: How do I manage notifications?

reportIssue.answer: Use the "Help & Support" section in your profile to report any issues you encounter.
reportIssue.question: How do I report an issue?

resetPassword.answer: Tap "Forgot Password" on the login screen and follow the instructions to reset your password via email.
resetPassword.question: How do I reset my password?

updateInfo.answer: Open Profile → Edit Profile to update your personal details at any time.
updateInfo.question: How can I update my information?

informationCollection.body: We collect essential information to enhance your experience. This includes details you provide directly, such as account data, as well as information gathered through usage analytics and cookies.
informationCollection.title: 1. Information Collection

informationSetting.body: You have full control over your data. Manage your privacy preferences, update personal details, and customize your settings to match your needs.
informationSetting.title: 3. Information Setting

informationUsage.body: The information collected is used to improve our services, provide personalized recommendations, and ensure a seamless experience. We do not share your data without your explicit consent.
informationUsage.title: 2. Information Usage

securityMeasures.body: We prioritize your data's safety with advanced security protocols, encryption methods, and regular audits to protect against unauthorized access or breaches.
securityMeasures.title: 4. Security Measures
